args.body: The catalogue agency bounded verdict is committed at products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake/bounded-verdict.json. description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified signals and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown and order coverage is unavailable. The agency subcontract screen found no original intake lead. Close that bounded test and advance Payhip using the official help capture after the pricing page returned HTTP 403.
